product.name: The Xperience Koh Samui Day Pass: Art Park Tickets
product.short: Day Pass to The Xperience, Koh Samui's immersive art park in Lipa Noi: 12 zones of giant sculptures, a heart-shaped lagoon beach club, pools, and a projection-mapping and fire show after dark. Open Wednesday to Sunday, 11:00–22:00 (Fridays to midnight).
product.notice: Open Wednesday to Sunday. Under-16s only on Family Days: Thursday, Saturday and Sunday.
included: Day Pass entry for your date, 11:00–22:00 (Fridays until midnight)
All 12 public art zones and 100+ artworks
The Playa lagoon beach club and the park's pools
Workshops and live events of the day
Projection mapping and fire show after dark
not_included: Food and drinks (no outside food or drink allowed)
Hotel transfers: add a private van with driver
itinerary: 15:00 | Arrive and take a golf cart to the top of the park
15:15 | Sky Bar, Art House, Alien Jungle and The Woods in daylight
16:30 | Swim at The Playa lagoon; early dinner at the beach club
17:55 | Sunset (November; later in summer) as the park lights up
18:30 | Labyrinth Lights, Luna projection mapping and the AfrikaBurn fire show
faq: What does The Xperience Day Pass include? | Entry for the whole day you choose, 11:00 to 22:00 (midnight on Fridays): all 12 public art zones, the lagoon and pools, the workshops and live events of the day, and the projection mapping and fire show after dark. Food, drinks, VIP areas and transport are extra.
How much are The Xperience tickets? | 1,500 THB per person, the park's own price, for adults and children aged 3 and over. Children aged 0–2 go free.
Which days can I book? | Wednesday to Sunday. The park is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. Online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thailand time.
Can I bring children? | Yes, on Family Days: Thursday, Saturday and Sunday. Wednesdays and Fridays are 16+ only, and the booking form only accepts children on Family Days.
How do I get my ticket? | After payment we book your entry with the park in your name for your date and email your confirmation. Show it at the entrance in Lipa Noi.

Is hotel pickup included? | No. The Xperience is in Lipa Noi on the west coast, 40–50 minutes from Chaweng. Add our private van with driver (8 hours, 4,500 THB for up to 10 people), and the driver waits and brings you back after the night show.

What is the cancellation policy? | Full refund if you cancel 48 hours or more before your visit date. No refund under 48 hours or for a no-show. If the park closes on your date, you choose a full refund or a new date.
What time should I arrive? | Around 15:00. Explore and swim while it's light, stay for sunset, then the light show and fire show. Plan 5–6 hours in total.
Can I bring food and drink? | No. Outside food and drink are not allowed; The Playa Beach Club, Mystic Café and the bars serve food and drinks in the park.

events.title: The Xperience After Dark
events.excerpt: Every Friday The Xperience art park in Lipa Noi stays open until midnight: DJs, illuminated sculptures, projection mapping and fire performers. 16+. Day Pass 1,500 THB.
events.content: Every Friday, The Xperience art park in Lipa Noi stays open from 11:00 until midnight. Spend the afternoon at the lagoon and pools, then stay as the 12 art zones light up: live DJs, illuminated sculptures, projection mapping on the giant figures, fire performers and sunset cocktails. Friday is 16+ only. The 1,500 THB Day Pass covers the whole day and night. Everything about the park is in our guide to The Xperience.

events.title: Family Day at The Xperience
events.excerpt: Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays are Family Days at The Xperience art park in Lipa Noi: all ages welcome, children 0–2 free, night light and fire show. Day Pass 1,500 THB.
events.content: On Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays, The Xperience art park in Lipa Noi welcomes all ages from 11:00 to 22:00. Explore 12 zones of giant sculptures, swim at the heart-shaped lagoon and stay for the night light show and fire show. Children 0–2 go free; from age 3 everyone pays the 1,500 THB Day Pass, and children must stay with a parent. Everything about the park is in our guide to The Xperience.

The Xperience art park

In the hills above Lipa Noi, The Xperience is Koh Samui's new immersive art park: 12 zones of giant sculptures, a heart-shaped lagoon beach club, pools and a projection-mapping and fire show after dark. It opens Wednesday to Sunday from 11:00 (Fridays until midnight); Day Pass tickets are 1,500 THB.

The Xperience art park on Family Days

On Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays, The Xperience in Lipa Noi welcomes children: giant sculptures, a heart-shaped lagoon, pools and a light show after dark. Children 0–2 go free and everyone from age 3 pays the 1,500 THB Day Pass. Wednesdays and Fridays are 16+ only. Book Family Day tickets.

New in 2026: The Xperience art park

The Xperience in Lipa Noi is a full afternoon and evening out: 12 zones of giant sculptures and light art, a lagoon beach club and pools, and projection mapping and fire shows after dark. Open Wednesday to Sunday, Day Pass 1,500 THB. Book tickets.

Friday nights at The Xperience

Every Friday, The Xperience art park in Lipa Noi stays open until midnight with DJs, illuminated sculptures, projection mapping and fire performers (16+, Day Pass 1,500 THB). It's 40–50 minutes from Chaweng, so book a driver for the way home.
